python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
df.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']

# Expense rows are 11-22 (0-indexed 10:22)
expenses = df.iloc[10:22][['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']].copy()
expenses['Amount'] = pd.to_numeric(expenses['Amount'], errors='coerce')

print('Per-item expenses:')
print(expenses.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(f'Total expenses (all categories): {expenses[\"Amount\"].sum():.2f}')
print()
by_cat = expenses.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
print('By category:')
print(by_cat.to_string())
"
